concerns.text: T006b [DEPENDS ON T006] is marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, T006b extends the file created by T006. If T006 is not completed, T006b cannot run. Marking a dependent extension task as parallel-safe violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule and creates a race condition if executed in parallel with T006.
T008b [DEPENDS ON T008a] is marked [P]. Similar to T006b, T008b extends the stats logic defined in T008a. It cannot be parallel-safe relative to T008a. The [P] tag is incorrect here.

T015b [P] extends T015a. The task description says 'Extend src/gatekeeper/rules.py'. A task that extends a file created in a preceding task cannot be parallel-safe with that preceding task. The [P] tag is invalid.

T026b and T026c are marked [P] but both depend on T026a. T026a defines the LMM formula and fitting logic. T026b/c implement fallbacks and stratified analysis based on that logic. They cannot run in parallel with T026a. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T016 [DEPENDS ON T014a] is correctly marked without [P], but T014a is marked [P]. T014a implements the classifier. T016 uses it. This is fine. However, T017 (Baseline execution) depends on the pipeline skeleton (T009) and likely the data loader (T006). While T017 is marked [P], it implicitly depends on the completion of T009 and T006. If T009 is not done, T017 fails. The [P] tag on T017 is risky if it implies independence from the foundational pipeline skeleton.

T028 [DEPENDS ON T026a, T026b, T026c] is correctly unmarked [P]. However, T023, T024, T025 (metrics) are marked [P]. T023/24/25 implement functions in `metrics.py`. T028 uses these functions. If T023/24/25 are not done, T028 fails. The [P] tag on T023-25 is acceptable relative to each other, but they must all complete before T028. The dependency chain is clear, but the [P] tag on T023-25 might mislead a scheduler to run T028 in parallel with them if the dependency is not strictly enforced by the runner.

T006b, T008b, T015b, T026b, T026c are marked [P] despite having explicit 'DEPENDS ON' clauses to the immediately preceding task (T006, T008a, T015a, T026a). This is a semantic contradiction. A task that extends another cannot be parallel-safe with the task it extends. Remove [P] from these tasks.
